about: Bridge / flyover deck edge class per OSM way, from street-level review (appearance only; no imagery stored). Fidelity pass round 2, lane world-b, 2026-11-12. Classes: parapet (solid concrete, game default), barrier (low concrete traffic barrier), kerb-railing (low kerb + steel post-and-rail), kerb-mesh (low kerb + steel posts with mesh panels), parapet-fence (concrete parapet + steel picket fence), basarab (drawn by basarab-structure.js, not by this table). Rows with applied=true are in game/src/bridge-guards.js.
